correctness.rationale: For Burek Example 14 K3 X in P4 and sigma=diag(1,-1,omega,omega^2,omega^2), the involution iota=sigma^3 flips x1 only; the quadric gives x1^2=a^2-bc+bd=Q, and the cubic invariant quotient is Y: F=a^3+b^3+c^3+abd+cd^2=0 in P3. The map X->Y is a double cover branched on C=V(F,Q). Independent exact Groebner calculations checked that the four projective charts of Y have no common gradient zero, and that the Jacobian-minor ideals of (F,Q) have no projective zero; hence Y and C are smooth, C of type (2,3) and genus4. Residual tau=diag(1,omega,omega^2,omega^2) has fixed eigenspaces two off-Y points and eigenline L(a=b=0), with F|L=c(c^2+d^2), three simple fixed points. Q|L=0 so all three on C. At each fixed point the fixed-line zero-weight direction is transverse to Y and the two tangent weights are (1,2), giving isolated 1/3(1,2) = A2 cyclic quotients. Tau is free in codimension1; K_Y=pi^*K_Z, K_Z^2=K_Y^2/3=1 and -K_Z ample, with three Gorenstein Du Val singularities, so degree-one 3A2 del Pezzo. The branch curve C quotient has genus1 from 6=3(2g-2)+3*2. Symbolic checks support precise critical loci; theoretical quotient and adjunction steps are explicitly reconstructed.
